h: Davido buys $2.1m Brabus Mercedes G-Wagon as birthday gift to himself
p: Davido has reportedly bought a Brabus XLP 800 Adventure Mercedes G 66, said to be worth $2.1 million, to mark his 34th birthday. A video of him driving it surfaced on Tuesday.
body: Afrobeats star Davido has treated himself to a luxury vehicle to mark his 34th birthday, reportedly spending about $2.1 million on a Brabus XLP 800 Adventure Mercedes G 66.
A video posted on Instagram on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, showed Davido taking his new car for a spin.

Davido, whose full name is David Adeleke, turned 34 on Saturday, 21 November. His wife Chioma and members of his 30BG crew surprised him with a cake on his private jet, and family and friends threw him a surprise party when he landed. He and Chioma were also named on Rolling Stone Africa's Power Couple 50 list.
In another clip that surfaced this week, the singer said he would never stop helping people, despite experiences of betrayal.
more: The car is reportedly worth $2.1 million.
